categories.functional: Behaviour, data and text a user sees in the app

categories.accessibility: Labels, alt text, contrast and keyboard order
categories.visual: Pixel-level layout, or only in Firefox or Edge
categories.security: Needs deliberate attacks or crafted API calls
categories.email: Only visible in emails the app sends
